dialogues.jp:
嬉しそうにニッコリ微笑む萌先輩。相変わらず、
微妙におかしな言葉の使用方法だが、今はつっ
こむ気になれない。
dialogues.en: Our cohabitation days are officially going to end.
dialogues.text: Our cohabitation days are officially going to end.

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp: 「今日のお夕飯は、お祝いですね」
商店街を歩きながら、萌先輩が｛てのひら／掌｝を合わせる。
dialogues.en: Moe-sempai clapped as we walked through the shopping arcade.
dialogues.text: Moe-sempai clapped as we walked through the shopping arcade.

dialogues.jp: 「いや、別にそんなのしなくても……」

ここまで来ておいてなんだけど、家にある材料
で充分だと思うんですけど……。
dialogues.en:
I think what we already have at home's more than enough for
dinner.
dialogues.text:
I think what we already have at home's more than enough for
dinner.

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp: 「ダメですよ。お祝い事はちゃんと祝わないと」

楽しそうに微笑みながら、横に並んで商店街を
歩いていく。
dialogues.en: She smiled joyfully and walked with me side by side.
dialogues.text: She smiled joyfully and walked with me side by side.

dialogues.jp:
まぁ、いいか。こういう風に買い物をするのも、
しばらくないかも知れないし。
dialogues.en:
Oh well. I guess we won't be shopping like this again for a
while.
dialogues.text:
Oh well. I guess we won't be shopping like this again for a
while.

dialogues.jp:
嬉しそうな萌先輩の笑顔を｛まぶた／瞼｝に焼きつけながら、
のんびりと買い物をするのだった……。
dialogues.en:
As I imprinted her joyful smile in my mind, I decided to go
shopping with her......
dialogues.text:
As I imprinted her joyful smile in my mind, I decided to go
shopping with her......

dialogues.jp:
健康だった。これで、萌先輩は家から出て行っ
てしまう。それは仕方の無いことだけど……。

萌先輩はお祝いだと言って、豪勢な料理を作る
べく、商店街を一緒にまわって、買い物をした
のだった。
dialogues.en:
Moe-sempai smiled joyfully. She was using the wrong words
again, but I didn't feel like making a comment about that.
dialogues.text:
Moe-sempai smiled joyfully. She was using the wrong words
again, but I didn't feel like making a comment about that.
